description:
Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

opencodex is a universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Grok Build: a local proxy that lets them run on many different LLM providers from a single port, translating between API wire formats.

Features:
- Works with Anthropic, Google, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Azure, DeepSeek, Ollama, and 40+ other built-in providers.
- Supports streaming, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
- Handles OAuth logins and a ChatGPT account pool.
- Native model picker in the Codex app, sub-agents, and search/vision sidecars.
Published to npm as @bitkyc08/opencodex@2.100.2 with dist-tag latest.
New Features
- Complete manual pause and resume for API key pools (#7636)
- Add bounded waits for stored Codex replies (#8090)
- Persist target cooldowns across restarts (#8117)
- Strip named hosted tools only beside client tools (#8499)
- Keep the Chat tool catalog stable across ToolSearch loads (opt-in dispatcher) (#8502)
- Opt in to skipping invalid /models rows (#8503)
- Gated remote ocx, Child update contract and observation cache (#8505)
- Show Child version, install kind and catalog freshness; ocx link check (#8508)
- Explicit health-gated resume, and login that clears an automatic pause (#8515)
Bug Fixes

- Wait for npm to serve a new version before verifying it (#8477)
- Match the Getting started startup step to OpenCodex Desktop (#8476)
- Fail over zero-output max_output_tokens terminal (#8222)
- Show Mistral API and Vibe budget usage (#8295)
- Show inactive model-scoped quota rows without routing on them (#8186)
- Pool-wide capacity estimate for the Anthropic account pool card (#8137)
- Leave Command Code credentials to the client (#8481)
- Recognize generic context-window overflow wording (#8130)
- Bring layout.json and the Anthropic pool doc back under their caps (#8485)
- Preserve native Messages for compatible key providers (#8488)
- Keep the provider's closed error class and finishReason on failure rows (#8489)
- Let retryOnReset replace chained native turns (#8486)
- Name the CallDynamicTool path for deferred client tools (#8492)
- Keep the Mistral budget helper off the core load path (#8498)
- Let a later final citation fill a missing title (#8491)
- Continue reasoning effort fallback (#8173)
- Flatten root tool-schema compositions for Claude models (#8490)
- Hop on opaque upstream 400 errors (#8162)
- Explain a rejected hub invite and startup-only config keys (#8495)
- Show a Child's tunnel state in ocx connect status (#8496)
- Remove unavailable Claude Desktop assignments from the dashboard (#8497)
- Retry a timed-out or refused-forward Child every minute from the Home (#8509)
- Send Gemini 4 Carbon requests with the CLI User-Agent (#8483)
Documentation
- Clarify Claude OAuth client version errors (#8482)
- Explain rate limits on caller-owned native passthrough (#8494)
- Describe tool search behind a gateway for current Claude Code (#8493)

Chores
